content_blocks.text: Thank you very much to all of you who submitted an essay for consideration by the Procurement Lawyers’ Association in the 2018-2019 Essay Competition, held in memory of our colleague, Rosie Choueka.
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2018-19 Winners

content_blocks.text: The standard of essays were particularly high this year and the question posed demanded a good grasp of the relevant legal framework. You provided our judges: Emily Heard of Bevan Brittan, John Houlden of Burges Salmon and Anthony Woolwich of Holman, Fenwick and Willan with a very tough task, but we are delighted to announce the top three ranked essayists as follows:

content_blocks.text:
Congratulations all!

We are currently
planning a date in the diary for our annual event – where Elizabeth will be
asked to present her essay and all three winners will be presented with their
prize cheques by the family of Rosie Choueka. It is a very special evening and
we hope that all essayists will be able to attend.
